item.title: docs(protocol): facts and feasibility questions reported by Bybifok
item.body:
**Problem.** Bybifok's legacy fixes (#3) and their prototype `moust4ki/ultra-hfr` surfaced HFR behaviours and open questions. These were only recorded in a branch of the old repository, which was never merged.

**What changed.** New section **`docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` §7b**, modelled on §7 (reports from redface2), with credit to Bybifok:
- **B1–B10**: reported protocol facts. Each one is cross-checked against our existing captures. Four are already settled (B8 MP `[non lu]`, B10 20 categories, and part of B1 and B9). The rest stay *unsettled* until a fixture shows them (AGENTS.md §3: no fact without evidence).
- **B11–B15**: feasibility questions to answer before a feature depends on them ("On t'a cité", deleting uploads on reho.st, BMP emoji, prefetching without moving flags, polite interval for a background check).

**Checks**: markdownlint, 0 errors. Docs only.

---
